topic: 专项练习 - 动名词与动词不定式辨析 (Gerunds and Infinitives)

questions.question: Emma decided _______ the school robotics club after visiting their science exhibition.
questions.explanation: 动词 decide 后面固定接动词不定式做宾语，即 decide to do sth.，意为“决定做某事”。

questions.question: Do you mind _______ the classroom window? It is getting quite chilly inside.
questions.explanation: mind 后面接动名词形式，即 mind doing sth.，表示“介意做某事”。

questions.question: The young pianist practiced _______ the sonata until she could play it perfectly from memory.
questions.explanation: practice 后接动名词作宾语，即 practice doing sth.，表示“练习做某事”。

questions.question: We are all really looking forward to _______ the National Space Museum this Friday.
questions.explanation: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后面必须接动名词形式 doing，意为“期待做某事”。

questions.question: During the long hike, Mr. Davies told the students to stop _______ some fresh mountain water.
questions.explanation: stop to do sth. 表示“停下当前做的事情去开始做另一件事”；stop doing sth. 表示“停止正在做的事”。此处指停下徒步去喝水，故选 to drink。

questions.question: The library is a quiet zone, so please stop _______ so loudly.
questions.explanation: stop doing sth. 意为“停止做某事”。在图书馆应停止大声说话，故用 talking。

questions.question: Please remember _______ off the projector before you leave the lecture hall.
questions.explanation: remember to do sth. 表示“记住去做某事（事情尚未做）”；remember doing sth. 表示“记得曾经做过某事”。此处是提醒离开前别忘了关投影仪，用 to turn。

questions.question: I clearly remember _______ my art project on Mrs. Green's desk yesterday morning.
questions.explanation: remember doing sth. 表示“记得做过某事”。句意为“我清楚地记得昨天早上把美术作业放在了格林老师的桌上”。

questions.question: He refused _______ any responsibility for breaking the antique vase.
questions.explanation: refuse 后接动词不定式，即 refuse to do sth.，意为“拒绝做某事”。

questions.question: _______ trees is one of the most effective ways to combat global warming.
questions.explanation: 动名词短语 Planting trees 放在句首充当句子的主语，谓语动词用单数 is。

questions.question: My elder brother avoided _______ during rush hour because the traffic was dreadful.
questions.explanation: avoid 后接动名词作宾语，即 avoid doing sth.，意为“避免做某事”。

questions.question: Our family cannot afford _______ on an overseas vacation this winter.
questions.explanation: afford 通常与 can/could 连用，后面接不定式，即 afford to do sth.，意为“担负得起做某事”。

questions.question: Sophia is remarkably good at _______ complex mathematical riddles.
questions.explanation: 介词 at 后面必须接动名词作宾语，be good at doing sth. 意为“擅长做某事”。

questions.question: The coach promised _______ the squad an extra break if they completed the drills well.
questions.explanation: promise 后接动词不定式做宾语，即 promise to do sth.，意为“承诺/答应做某事”。

questions.question: Have you finished _______ your personal reflective essay for English class?
questions.explanation: finish 后固定接动名词形式作宾语，即 finish doing sth.，意为“完成做某事”。

questions.question: My parents never allow us _______ television until all homework is completed.
questions.explanation: allow sb. to do sth. 意为“允许某人做某事”，接带 to 的不定式作宾语补足语。

questions.question: The sign clearly states that the museum does not allow _______ with flash.
questions.explanation: allow 后面若没有接人作宾语，直接接动词时要用动名词，即 allow doing sth.，表示“允许做某事”。

questions.question: After several attempts, Oliver finally managed _______ the difficult puzzle.
questions.explanation: manage 后接动词不定式，即 manage to do sth.，意为“设法成功完成某事”。

questions.question: The teacher suggested _______ a brainstorming session before writing the draft.
questions.explanation: suggest 后面直接接动词时必须用动名词形式，即 suggest doing sth.，意为“建议做某事”，不能接 suggest to do。

questions.question: I would like _______ you to my birthday celebration next Saturday.
questions.explanation: would like 意为“想要”，后接动词不定式，即 would like to do sth.。

questions.question: Don't forget _______ your umbrella; the weather forecast predicts heavy showers.
questions.explanation: forget to do sth. 意为“忘记去做某事（事情还没做）”；forget doing sth. 意为“忘记做过某事”。此处是提醒带伞，用 to bring。

questions.question: I'll never forget _______ the Northern Lights for the first time in Norway.
questions.explanation: forget doing sth. 表示“忘记做过某件事”。句意指“我永远不会忘记第一次在挪威看极光的经历”。

questions.question: Liam spent nearly three hours _______ his messy bedroom over the weekend.
questions.explanation: spend + 时间 + (in) doing sth. 是固定句型，表示“花费时间做某事”，接动名词 tidying。

questions.question: The doctor advised my uncle to give up _______ sugary beverages.
questions.explanation: give up 是动词短语，up 是介词，介词后面必须接动名词形式，give up doing sth. 意为“放弃/戒掉做某事”。

questions.question: If your throat feels sore, try _______ warm water with honey.
questions.explanation: try doing sth. 意为“尝试一下某种方法/试验某事”；try to do sth. 意为“尽力/努力去做某事”。此处指尝试喝蜂蜜温水缓解嗓子痛，故用 drinking。

questions.question: We tried our best _______ the steep cliff, but the rocks were too slippery.
questions.explanation: try to do sth. / try one's best to do sth. 意为“尽力做某事、努力克服困难去做某事”，因此用 to climb。

questions.question: Instead of _______ television all afternoon, why don't we ride our bikes outside?
questions.explanation: instead of 中的 of 是介词，介词后必须接动名词 doing 做宾语。

questions.question: Although the homework was tough, Lucas refused _______ for help.
questions.explanation: refuse to do sth. 意为“拒绝做某事”，后面接动词不定式。

questions.question: My grandmother taught me how _______ a knitted winter scarf.
questions.explanation: “疑问词 (how/what/where) + 不定式 (to do)”构成不定式短语，常充当宾语，此处意为“如何制作”。

questions.question: Our English teacher encouraged all students _______ part in the annual debate competition.
questions.explanation: encourage sb. to do sth. 意为“鼓励某人做某事”，动词不定式作宾语补足语。
